messages:
marco: kicking off a 0.75% canary for v6-quant-small (hybrid-4bit) focused on promotion oscillation risk. main alarms: rerank NDCG@10, structured field exact-match, and tail latency p99. auto-fallback rules below.

lee: curious  what's the specific oscillation risk you saw in earlier rollouts?

marco: earlier promotes showed periodic oscillations where a small traffic bump caused rerank churn -> user-facing ranking regressions. hypothesis: quantized attention kernel non-determinism under small batch windows.

ana: add watch slice 'midtail_rerank' and 'forms_structured' and pin enterprise partner 'gamma-labs' to fp16 until canary finishes.

marco: done. gate config snippet:
```
canary_fraction: 0.0075
watch_slices: ["midtail_rerank","forms_structured","short_q"]
metrics:
  rerank_ndcg10: {threshold_rel: -1.8%, window_s: 600, action: immediate_rollback}
  structured_exact: {threshold_abs: -1.0%, window_s: 300, action: rollback_after_repeat}
  latency_p99: {threshold_rel: +6%, window_s: 300, action: alert}
autofallback_cooldown: 1800  # block re-promote for 30m after rollback
notify: ["#eng-ml","#oncall"]
report_interval_s: 120
```

ci-bot: canary run started. cohorts: midtail_rerank(n=250), forms_structured(n=150), short_q(n=200). smoke snapshot every 2m.

lee: add a concordance check for critical fields: if structured_exact drops >0.8% AND a semantic-diff rate >0.6% absolute then escalate immediate rollback.

marco: added concordance guard. also enabling sample_diffs_on_trigger.

ci-bot: t+2m: rerank_ndcg10 delta = -0.4% (ok), structured_exact delta = -0.3% (ok), latency_p99 delta = +1.2% (ok).

ci-bot: t+8m: midtail_rerank ndcg10 delta = -1.9% -> triggers immediate rollback. posting sample diffs to secure store. initiating circuit-breaker and scaling v6-quant-small to 0.0.

marco: ack. freezing all automated promos. pulling representative diffs to thread.

lee: did the diffs show batch-size dependent artifacts? any correlation with small-batch attention paths?

marco: initial look: 6/15 diffs show rank inversion for items whose latent signals were surface-level; looks like attention softmax quant rounding skew. filing ticket ML-4812 for quant-kernel calibration and deterministic-seed enforce.

ana: follow-ups: 1) disable hybrid-4bit kernel in canary pool and re-run 2) increase midtail_rerank samples to 1k for stability 3) extend autofallback_cooldown to 1h if repeat rollback within 24h.

marco: will open PRs and schedule 45m triage. oncall, please monitor for any spillover to adjacent shards.

oncall: monitoring enabled. alert policy updated to page SRE on any repeat rollback within 15m.

marco: summary: canary rolled back due to ndcg10 -1.9% on midtail_rerank. circuit-breaker applied, pins set, diffs captured, follow-ups assigned. will update after triage. thanks all :white_check_mark:
